name: metrics_snapmk
description: Metrics of one snapmk tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned to its CPU

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

job_state.description: Snapshot creation job state: 0=idle (Idle, waiting for a job), 1=start (Starting), 2=tar_headers (Writing tar headers), 3=manifest (Writing manifest), 4=accdb_cache (Writing cached accounts), 5=accdb_cache_flush (Flushing cached accounts), 6=accdb_cache_finish (Waiting for cached account flush), 7=accdb_disk (Writing on-disk accounts), 8=accdb_disk_flush (Flushing on-disk accounts), 9=accdb_disk_finish (Waiting for on-disk account flush), 10=accdb_delta (Writing incremental accounts), 11=accdb_delta_flush (Flushing incremental accounts), 12=accdb_delta_finish (Waiting for incremental account flush), 13=status_cache (Writing status cache), 14=eof_marker (Writing tar EOF marker), 15=done (Done, notifying replay), 16=fail (Failed, cleaning up), 17=sleep (Sleeping), 18=startup (Waiting for startup), 19=startup_burst (Publishing pre-existing snapshots)

snapshot_started.description: Snapshot creation jobs started, by snapshot type

snapshot_finished.description: Snapshot creation jobs finished successfully, by snapshot type

last_started_slot.description: Slot of the most recently started snapshot creation, by snapshot type, 0 if none since boot

last_finished_slot.description: Slot of the most recently finished snapshot creation, by snapshot type, 0 if none since boot

compress_consumed_bytes.description: Uncompressed bytes fed to the compressor

disk_written_bytes.description: Compressed bytes written to snapshot files

cache_progress_bytes.description: Bytes of the accounts database cache region scanned so far for the snapshot being created. Resets when a snapshot starts and holds at the total once the cached accounts phase finishes. Stays zero for an incremental snapshot, which does not scan the cache

cache_expected_bytes.description: Size of the accounts database cache region a cached accounts phase scans

incremental_account_progress.description: Accounts changed since the base snapshot that have been written so far for the incremental snapshot being created. Resets when a snapshot starts, and stays zero for a full snapshot, which has no changed account walk

incremental_account_expected.description: Accounts changed since the base snapshot, sampled when the incremental snapshot started; 0 for a full snapshot. Replay may record more changes while the job runs, so progress can exceed this

incremental_account_used.description: Distinct accounts changed in rooted slots since the last full snapshot job started; saturates at IncrementalAccountCapacity

incremental_account_capacity.description: Maximum changed accounts that can be tracked; once reached, no incremental snapshot can be created until the next full snapshot

disk_allocated_bytes.description: Logical bytes allocated across managed snapshot files, including partial and retained files
